title: Lesson 4 Checkpoint — Questions with To Be
description: Show what you learned about questions with to be. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can ask and answer basic questions using the verb to be.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Where are you from? — Me am from Brazil.
Where are you from? — I am from Brazil.
questions.answer: Where are you from? — I am from Brazil.
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Questions with To Be: Invert am/is/are and the subject for yes/no questions. Wh- questions start with What, Where, Who, How, etc. + am/is/are

questions.question: Complete: Where ___ you from? — I am from Brazil.
questions.explanation: Invert am/is/are and the subject for yes/no questions. Wh- questions start with What, Where, Who, How, etc. + am/is/are + subject.

questions.question: True or false: "Where are you from? — I am from Brazil." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: ___ he your brother? — Yes, he is.
questions.explanation: Invert am/is/are and the subject for yes/no questions. Wh- questions start with What, Where, Who, How, etc. + am/is/are + subject.
